plugins.name: harnmem
plugins.description: Cross-harness persistent memory for Grok CLI: a byte-stable memory index via the MCP server's initialize.instructions, six memory tools, a /harnmem:memory command, and SessionEnd extraction from Grok's own session transcript. The plugin id matches the Claude Code adapter so Grok's same-name precedence shadows an auto-loaded claude-harnmem instead of duplicating its MCP server and extractor.
